name: Are chemical drain cleaners effective for recurring clogs?

mainEntity.name: Are chemical drain cleaners effective for recurring clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Chemical drain cleaners are generally not recommended for recurring clogs. While they might temporarily clear a minor blockage, they often fail to address the underlying cause of persistent issues. Furthermore, harsh chemicals can damage pipes over time, especially older ones, and can be hazardous if not handled properly. For recurring problems, professional diagnosis and treatment are safer and more effective solutions that provide a lasting repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Chemical drain cleaners are not recommended for recurring clogs as they don't address underlying issues and can damage pipes. Professional solutions are safer and more effective.
